title: story_of_keesh
author: london
summary: A poor Inuit boy named Keesh rises to become head man of his village by cleverly hunting polar bears with an ingenious whalebone-and-blubber trap, which the villagers suspect is witchcraft until he reveals it is simply "headcraft."

issues.description: Numerous U+00A0 non-breaking space characters appear throughout the text, likely from HTML extraction, but they do not impair readability.
